dialogues.jp: 「あー……いい天気だなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Aaahhh.... good weather today."
dialogues.text: "Aaahhh.... good weather today."

dialogues.jp:
まるでトンネルのような桜の向こう側に広がる
青空を見て、俺は呟いた。
dialogues.en:
After breaking through what seemed like a tunnel of sakura
petals, I finally could look at the blue sky above.
dialogues.text:
After breaking through what seemed like a tunnel of sakura
petals, I finally could look at the blue sky above.

dialogues.jp:
「こんな日は家で一日中ごろごろしてるのが幸
　せってもんだよなぁ……」
dialogues.en:
"This kind of day would be perfect for just lazing around at
home..."
dialogues.text:
"This kind of day would be perfect for just lazing around at
home..."

dialogues.jp:
飯を食うのも忘れて、ただベッドの中で延々と
微睡む……。
dialogues.en:
Forgetting about breakfast, lying in bed and slowly dozing
off...
dialogues.text:
Forgetting about breakfast, lying in bed and slowly dozing
off...

dialogues.jp: ああ、なんと幸せなことかっ！
dialogues.en: That would be true happiness!
dialogues.text: That would be true happiness!

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それって、いい天気とあまり関係ないと思う
　んですけど」
dialogues.en: "I don't think that has anything to do with good weather..."
dialogues.text: "I don't think that has anything to do with good weather..."

dialogues.jp: 柔らかく響く声に、俺は振り返った。
dialogues.en: A meek voice from behind caused me to turn my head.
dialogues.text: A meek voice from behind caused me to turn my head.

dialogues.jp: ことりが苦笑を浮かべながら立っていた。
dialogues.en: Kotori had a sheepish smile on her face.
dialogues.text: Kotori had a sheepish smile on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「現実逃避だからな」
dialogues.en: "Just escaping reality for awhile."
dialogues.text: "Just escaping reality for awhile."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっさり言いますね」
dialogues.en: "Just like you, hee."
dialogues.text: "Just like you, hee."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに今日のテスト、やばいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "How are you feeling for today's test? Uneasy?"
dialogues.text: "How are you feeling for today's test? Uneasy?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。自慢じゃないが、授業はいつも寝てる
　からな。試験範囲すらおぼろげだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh. I'm not exactly proud to say this, but I'm always
sleeping during lessons. And the exam scope is pretty vague
as well."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh. I'm not exactly proud to say this, but I'm always
sleeping during lessons. And the exam scope is pretty vague
as well."

dialogues.jp: わずかながら胸を反らして言う。
dialogues.en: I slump over slightly.
dialogues.text: I slump over slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それ、ほんとに自慢になりませんよ」
dialogues.en: "That's really something not to be proud of..."
dialogues.text: "That's really something not to be proud of..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「むぅ。やっぱりか」
dialogues.en: "Mm. That's why I'm worried."
dialogues.text: "Mm. That's why I'm worried."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ま、立ち話も何だし。歩こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "Well, no reason to just stand here and talk. Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Well, no reason to just stand here and talk. Let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 並んで歩き出す。
dialogues.en: We start walking side-by-side.
dialogues.text: We start walking side-by-side.

dialogues.jp: 「けど……ことりはいいよな」
dialogues.en: "But... you're really good, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "But... you're really good, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何がですか？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「テスト前の一夜漬けとかやらないだろ？」
dialogues.en: "You don't need to do last-minute cramming, right?"
dialogues.text: "You don't need to do last-minute cramming, right?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりは見た目が可愛いだけじゃなくて、頭も
良い。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's not just a pretty face, she has a good head as
well.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's not just a pretty face, she has a good head as
well.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、確かにあまりやりませんね」
dialogues.en: "Well, sort of..."
dialogues.text: "Well, sort of..."

dialogues.jp: 顎に人差し指を当てて頷くことり。
dialogues.en: Kotori stroked her chin with her index finger and nodded.
dialogues.text: Kotori stroked her chin with her index finger and nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「授業中にポイントをしっかり押さえちゃいま
　すから。テスト前にすることと言ったら、そ
　れの見直しくらいかな？」
dialogues.en:
"I do look over the points I take down during lessons the
night before an exam. Besides, the teacher did say the exam
scope."
dialogues.text:
"I do look over the points I take down during lessons the
night before an exam. Besides, the teacher did say the exam
scope."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、どこら辺が出題されるか、ヤマはわ
　かってると？」
dialogues.en: "Then you know roughly what will come out on the exam?"
dialogues.text: "Then you know roughly what will come out on the exam?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
dialogues.en: "Uh huh."
dialogues.text: "Uh huh."

dialogues.jp: なんと。
dialogues.en: I see.
dialogues.text: I see.

dialogues.jp: それはいいことを聞いたぞ。
dialogues.en: Maybe I could make use of this.
dialogues.text: Maybe I could make use of this.

dialogues.jp:
今からテスト開始時間までそう多いわけじゃな
いが、それでも全くないわけじゃない。
dialogues.en:
There may not be that much time till the exam, but I don't
have to go in knowing absolutely nothing.
dialogues.text:
There may not be that much time till the exam, but I don't
have to go in knowing absolutely nothing.

dialogues.jp:
ヤマを押さえて勉強すれば、多少マシになるは
ず！
dialogues.en: If I do this, I might not be in as much trouble as I think!
dialogues.text: If I do this, I might not be in as much trouble as I think!

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp: 無邪気な笑顔を浮かべることり。
dialogues.en: Kotori gave me an innocent smile.
dialogues.text: Kotori gave me an innocent smile.

dialogues.jp: 「あー……なんというかその……」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... how do I say this..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... how do I say this..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「…………何でもない。忘れてくれ」
dialogues.en: "......Never mind. Just forget it."
dialogues.text: "......Never mind. Just forget it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
今から集中して詰め込めば何とかなるかも知れ
ない……。
dialogues.en:
I can barely concentrate now, I won't be able to cram much
more in...
dialogues.text:
I can barely concentrate now, I won't be able to cram much
more in...

dialogues.jp:
だけど、今さらジタバタするのなんてみっとも
ないと思ったのだ。
dialogues.en:
And there's no real point in putting up a hopeless struggle
now.
dialogues.text:
And there's no real point in putting up a hopeless struggle
now.

dialogues.jp:
何より、血眼になってことりにヤマを聞いてい
る俺の姿は、無様以外の何ものでもない。
dialogues.en:
Besides, I don't really want to disgrace myself any further
in front of her, already appearing before with these
bloodshot eyes.
dialogues.text:
Besides, I don't really want to disgrace myself any further
in front of her, already appearing before with these
bloodshot eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「男の子、なんですね」
dialogues.en: "That's how boys are like, huh."
dialogues.text: "That's how boys are like, huh."

dialogues.jp: ことりが微笑みを浮かべた。
dialogues.en: Kotori continued smiling.
dialogues.text: Kotori continued smiling.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何か言ったか？」
dialogues.en: "Mm? What did you say?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? What did you say?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「頑張ってくださいねって言ったんですよ」
dialogues.en: "I said do your best for the exams."
dialogues.text: "I said do your best for the exams."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう。任せとけ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, you can count on me."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, you can count on me."

dialogues.jp:
運も実力のうちということで、持てる限りの運
を使って頑張るか。
dialogues.en:
I'd have to count on the powers of my luck to pull me
through.
dialogues.text:
I'd have to count on the powers of my luck to pull me
through.

dialogues.jp:
そう決めた俺の横で、ことりが何だか楽しそう
に笑っていた。
dialogues.en:
As I decide that, Kotori for some reason started smiling
happily.
dialogues.text:
As I decide that, Kotori for some reason started smiling
happily.

dialogues.jp: ◆男の意地◆
dialogues.en: ◆A Man's Backbone◆
dialogues.text: ◆A Man's Backbone◆

dialogues.jp:
いよいよテストが始まる日。俺が現実逃避して
いると、ことりに出会った。
dialogues.en:
It's now the first day of tests. Kotori caught me in the
midsts of one of my traversals into an alternate reality.
dialogues.text:
It's now the first day of tests. Kotori caught me in the
midsts of one of my traversals into an alternate reality.

dialogues.jp:
成績優秀なことりにテストのヤマを聞こうとも
思ったが、それはあれだ。男として格好悪い。
dialogues.en:
With her academic excellence and her basic understanding of
the exam scope, I thought of trying to finagle it out of
her, but eventually thought better of it.
dialogues.text:
With her academic excellence and her basic understanding of
the exam scope, I thought of trying to finagle it out of
her, but eventually thought better of it.

dialogues.jp: 俺は実力で乗り切ることにした。
dialogues.en: I'd rely on my own power for it.
dialogues.text: I'd rely on my own power for it.
